text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. You know, someone told me 
something."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For Hayahide-san, how to win the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
choice_data_list:
They actually taught you something like 
that!?

They actually taught you something like 
that!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm suuuuper exhausted though~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Looking forward to working with you again 
today, Hayahide-san!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Did you bring the notebook where you 
recorded your recent weight?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, so out of the blue~? Hayahide-san, 
you pervert~.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey now. Fluctuations in weight are 
directly tied to muscle mass gains and 
stamina. Calculating your pace 
distribution accordingly is also...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I get it~. Alright then, let's 
do this!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... whew, haah... How did that 
look~? That last run~

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're getting out of breath less than 
before. I heard your trainer reviewed your 
baseline stamina as part of your plan, and 
it seems to be paying off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, your arm swing is lacking. If you 
rely solely on your legs, you won't last 
until the end. If I'm to formulate a 
formula just for you—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right on. Taking notes now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? Hayahide, what about the others~?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...You're truly diligent. Ever since I 
instructed you once to take notes, you've 
obediently taken them every time since.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, Hayahide told me to do it that way 
in the first place, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Being able to put things into action 
immediately is a great virtue, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...That said, there are times she asks 
about the meaning of terminology I've 
explained over and over again.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's, um... well... Like, "Hayahide-san, 
super huge thanks for always teaching me 
stuff"?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, my basic rule is to just give it my 
all! Stupid as I am!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...'Cause I've got people who believe that 
I can pull off something truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you aim for the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
then allow me to impart one final, most 
crucial teaching upon you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...A lesson?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. How to win the Tenno Sho (Spring)... 
no, how to win any race. Speaking from my 
own experience—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, just hang in there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"To the horse girls beside me, behind me, 
and ahead of me. 'I'm not giving up 
victory to anyone!' she declared."

Meanwhile, the stands at Kyoto Racecourse 
were bustling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this year's lineup is crazy good. Is 
that wild child coming too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but my favorite to win is probably 
Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...You're seriously making Golshi your 
favorite to win? She's way beyond the 
realm of favorites or contenders.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, that's why you're my favorite! My one 
and only favorite, that is!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, you're finally here. I've been 
waiting for you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look, check out the faces in the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ha, don't you get it? This is the 
prestigious stage of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Now... which one are you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Soy sauce or Worcestershire sauce on 
sunny-side up eggs... Which faction are 
you on... dammit?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm on team mayo, though?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...*Clang!*

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the battle gong has sounded. It's 
rung! I won't be satisfied until I capture 
you as a specimen of purebred idiocy!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? That makes zero sense! Stop using 
such scary words, would ya!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well... to be real, you're pretty crazy 
yourself, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Forget the audience for a second. Coming 
all the way out to this mountain just to 
become mushrooms and bamboo shoots with me 
is totally abnormal, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright then, let's settle this. Let's 
find out who's the biggest idiot!"
